evals.prompt: Upload the current dev build to the deployment path in datacoolie.yml.
evals.expected_output: Run both local validations, pin current/manifest.json build_id, read deployment_path from datacoolie.yml, upload the retained artifact first and current second.

evals.prompt: Upload an explicitly selected retained build for qa.
evals.expected_output: Validate the selected artifact, report limited scope when project history is unavailable, and map its qa tree to both target prefixes.
expectations: Manifest is not a deployment-path source

evals.prompt: Release a project whose environment has no deployment_path.
evals.expected_output: Fail before any transfer and ask the project owner to configure environments.<env>.deployment_path.
expectations: No fallback to manifest or guessed target

evals.expected_output: Run the upload command, record its exit code and failed artifact-phase output as evidence, and do not attempt the current upload.

evals.prompt: The artifact upload succeeds but current upload fails.
evals.expected_output: Report partial_failure, keep the immutable artifact, and retry the same pinned build later.

evals.prompt: Repeat an upload of the same build.
evals.expected_output: Treat matching relative paths as safe overwrite/retry; retain unrelated target files.

evals.prompt: A build has two independently packaged functions roots.
evals.expected_output: Upload both roots as ordinary files in the environment tree; do not expect a singular functions_artifact or install them.
expectations: Platform attachment is out of scope

evals.prompt: The deployment path contains spaces and Unicode.
evals.expected_output: Pass an argument vector to the official upload tool and preserve the path exactly.
